meta.title: Kashi — The City of Light
meta.description: Kashi — ghats, temples, Sarnath and the story of every faith. One journey from night to dawn on the Ganga.

hero.title: Kashi — older than history itself
hero.titleSecondary: काशी — जो इतिहास से भी पुरानी है
hero.subtitle: A single lamp is lit in the dark. The ghats wake. The Ganga keeps flowing, the way it has for longer than anyone remembers.

day.title: A day in Kashi
day.intro: In a single day the city is born three times: at dawn on the river, at noon in the lanes, and at dusk in the flame of the aarti.
day.hint: Scroll to move through the day

dawn.title: Subah-e-Banaras
dawn.caption: The sun rises from the far bank. A conch sounds, the boats push off, and the steps slowly fill.

noon.title: Noon in the galis
noon.caption: The smell of kachori, the flash of brass, silk threads on a loom, and a small shrine at every turn.

dusk.title: Ganga Aarti
dusk.caption: Seven tiered lamps rise together. Bells, conch, smoke, and the whole ghat catches like a single flame.
